forceOrg.raw: max 1 per 2000 points; warlord unless Epic Hero+Leader

Your army can only include 1 Overlord for every 2,000 points. If you have 1 or more Overlord units in your army, 1 of those units must be your Warlord, unless your army also includes an Epic Hero unit with the Leader ability.

sections.prose: 1 Overlord
This model is equipped with a Staff of Light.

My Will Be Done: During your Command Phase, select up to 3 enemy units to be the target of this ability, and up to 3 friendly units to benefit from this ability. Select 1 of the following abilities that those friendly unit(s) will benefit from when making attacks against the selected enemy unit(s) the duration of the Battle Round:

  • Friendly units score Critical Hits on a 4+ against the selected enemy unit
  • Friendly units score Critical Wounds on a 3+ against the selected enemy unit
  • Friendly units gain the Precision ability on the selected enemy unit.

If you choose to select only 1 enemy unit as the target of this ability, your selected friendly units benefit from all of the above abilities.

Your army can only include 1 Overlord for every 2,000 points. If you have 1 or more Overlord units in your army, 1 of those units must be your Warlord, unless your army also includes an Epic Hero unit with the Leader ability.

sections.label: Path of Study
sections.prose: This model must select 1 of the following Paths of Study, which determines its Wargear and some Abilities as described under each Path.

profiles.name: Technomancer
profiles.abilities: Necrodermicon: whilst this model is leading - or has joined - a unit, models in that unit gain the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. Additionally, this model can use the Necrodermis ability even all models in the unit it is leading (or has joined) have been destroyed.

profiles.name: Chronomancer
profiles.abilities: Timesplinterer: Enemy units subtract 1 from their Hit rolls when making Ranged attacks against units that this model is leading, or has joined.

profiles.name: Psychomancer
profiles.abilities: Harbinger of Despair: During your Command Phase, select 1 enemy unit that is within 18" of and visible to this model. When your opponent activates that unit, it must first take a Battle Shock test using a Leadership characteristic of 9+ before completing any Actions.

profiles.name: Plasmancer
profiles.abilities: Lightning Arc: whilst this model is leading - or has joined - a unit, Ranged attacks made by that unit against enemy models within 12" of this model score 1 Mortal Wound for each Critical Wound in addition to any damage inflicted by that attack.

sections.label: Harnessed God
sections.prose: Each Shard of Transcendent C'Tan is a shard of a specific god harnessed by a Necron noble to do their bidding. This unit must select 1 of the following Harnessed Gods to be a Shard of, which determines its Wargear and Abilities as described.

profiles.name: Shard of the Deceiver

clauses.prose: Deceiver's Grace

profiles.abilities: Temporal Illusion: Once per Battle Round, when this model is selected as the subject of a Ranged attack or a Charge and Fight Action, remove the model from the tabletop and immediately place it back on the tabletop anywhere that is more than 12" from its original position, and not within 6" of any enemy models.

profiles.name: Shard of the Nightbringer

clauses.prose: Gaze of Death
Nightbringer's Scythe

profiles.abilities: The Reaping: Once per battle round, select 1 enemy unit anytime during your activation that is within 6" of this model and which has no models with a Toughness characteristic higher than 5. Roll a D6. On a 2, up to 3 models from that unit are destroyed. On a 3-5, up to D3+3 models from that unit are destroyed. On a 5, up to D6+1 models from that unit are destroyed. On a 6, up to D6+4 models from that unit are destroyed.

profiles.name: Shard of the Void Dragon

clauses.prose: Void Dragon's Spear

profiles.abilities: Matter Absorption: At the start of your activation for this unit, select one enemy Vehicle within 12" of this model and roll one D6. On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3+2 mortal wounds and this model regains that many lost wounds (or as many as it can get until it returns to Full Strength).

profiles.name: Unformed Shard
profiles.abilities: Untethered God: At the start of each Battle Round, roll a D6. On a 1, this unit cannot be activated this Battle Round. On a 2, this model assumes the Wargear and Abilities of the Shard of the Deceiver until the end of the Battle Round. On a 3, this model assumes the Wargear and Abilities of the Shard of the Nightbringer until the end of the Battle Round. On a 4, this model assumes the Wargear and Abilities of the Shard of the Void Dragon until the end of the Battle Round. On a 5, you select which Harnessed God this model will be a Shard of until the end of the Battle Round. On a 6, this unit is destroyed and every unit within 12" of it takes D6 Mortal Wounds.

sections.prose: 2 to 6 Canoptek Scarabs

Self-Destruct Protocol: Each time a model from this unit is in base-to-base contact with an enemy unit, you can choose to use this ability instead of making a Melee attack. To do so, select the enemy as the subject of this attack and roll a D6. On a 1, nothing occurs and the model is destroyed. On a 2 to 4, the enemy unit suffers D3 Mortal Wounds, on a 5 or 6, the enemy unit suffers D6 Mortal Wounds. Models that use this ability are permanently destroyed and cannot use the Necrodermis ability.

  • Friendly Necron Infantry units held in Strategic Reserves can disregard the typical rules when they Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves and may instead be placed wholly within 3" of this model, but not in Base-to-Base Contact with any enemy models.
  • As soon as enemy models with a Toughness characteristic of 4 or less enter into Base-to-Base Contact with this model, each must roll a D6. On a roll of a 1 or a 6, the models are immediately destroyed.
